basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer living in Portland, Oregon. Passionate about sustainable living, I spend my free time growing microgreens and exploring the latest anime series, with a particular fondness for 'Symphogear XDU'. I also enjoy engaging in self-improvement communities like NoFap. I work remotely, which allows me to balance my hobbies and professional life seamlessly. I'm currently single and enjoy participating in local community gardening projects on the weekends. I'm typically online during late evenings and early mornings, often diving into discussions or sharing insights with others.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, I've honed my skills through years of experience in the tech industry. I've also developed a keen interest in permaculture and organic farming, largely self-taught through online courses and community workshops.
